summary:
Meta EPS與營收雙超預期，廣告與AI投資回報強勁。
• EPS 7.31美元，超出預期6.82美元，驚喜幅度7.20%。
• 營收563.1億美元，年增33.08%，成長動能顯著加速。
• AI驅動的廣告推薦與內容排序提升變現效率。
• 本益比僅21.68倍，相對成長性估值具吸引力。
• 用戶參與度與廣告載入優化持續支撐核心業務。
ai_view:
訊號強勁正向：EPS與營收雙超預期，33%營收年增顯示廣告與AI變現飛輪加速。短中期股價有基本面支撐，且21.68倍本益比在大型科技股中估值合理，提供下檔保護。追蹤指標：廣告營收年增、每用戶平均收入、資本支出與AI投資回報、Reality Labs虧損收斂。只要核心廣告維持雙位數成長，估值仍具吸引力。

需留意：Reality Labs持續虧損，拖累整體營業利益。；AI基礎設施資本支出大幅攀升，須觀察投資回報。；廣告業務受總體經濟與監管變化影響。

summary_en:
Meta beats on EPS and revenue as ad and AI investments pay off.
• EPS of $7.31 beat the $6.82 estimate, a 7.20% surprise.
• Revenue of $56.31B grew 33.08% YoY, a notable acceleration.
• AI-driven ad recommendation and content ranking boost monetization efficiency.
• P/E of just 21.68 looks attractive relative to growth.
• User engagement and ad-load optimization continue to support the core business.

ai_view_en:
Signal strongly positive: beats on both EPS and revenue, with 33% revenue growth showing the ad and AI monetization flywheel accelerating. Near to mid-term, fundamentals support the stock, and a 21.68 P/E is reasonable among megacaps, offering downside protection. Track: ad revenue growth, ARPU, capex and AI ROI, and Reality Labs loss narrowing. As long as core ads grow double digits, the valuation remains attractive.

Watch：Reality Labs continues to lose money, weighing on operating income.; Surging AI infrastructure capex requires monitoring of returns.; Ad revenue remains exposed to macro and regulatory shifts.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+7.20%，營收年增33.08%，廣告動能強勁。
